name: Counter Assault
summary: Counter Assault is a free-to-play 5v5 tactical first-person shooter developed by palali, a solo developer from Turkey. Its modes are Bomb, in which one team plants a bomb at one of two sites while the other defends or defuses it with a per-round money economy; Team Deathmatch and Deathmatch, which use a weapon ladder; and Zombie, in which three zombies try to infect seven humans. The game can be played in ranked online matches with cross-play between iOS and Android, on a local network (LAN) for up to 16 players, or offline against bots and in a 16-mission offline campaign. It features 24 weapons, three maps and cosmetic-only skins. Not to be confused with the 2017 game Counter Assault - Online FPS by BlackHammer.
